name: @enforcer/core
description: Deterministic tool-call deny floor with tool-substitution redirects (sed->slice/rg, awk-writes, rm -rf /, git push --force, secret-writes, curl|sh). Pure, no LLM, harness-agnostic. Consumed by the claude PreToolUse hook and the @enforcer/pi-enforcer extension.

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
